numbering_override: User requested the next development line be v2.0. Release candidates mark incomplete work; stable v2.0.0 still requires the evidence milestone. The original v1 policy and its source hash remain preserved as historical evidence.

phases.name: Observer and reserve development
phases.rule: Use development only; change one mechanism at a time; tune PI independently with identical measurement channels and actuator limits. Retain every candidate and failure.
phases.remaining: Conservative zero-return reserve prevents floor crossings in the recorded development grid but incurs excessive oxygen deficit. Develop explicit, testable less restrictive inflow protection; retune matched PI before freezing. No confirmation executed.

phases.name: Freeze candidate, comparator and analysis
phases.rule: Freeze source hashes, selected settings, comparator eligibility, patient distribution, fault grid, units, paired analysis and all gates before confirmation.

phases.name: Two independent confirmation cohorts
phases.rule: Same frozen design in both cohorts. No confirmation-driven selection. If a design changes, archive failures, use development and register new unseen cohorts. Pass all primary regimes separately.

phases.name: Stable v2.0.0 release
phases.rule: All declared gates and checks on Python 3.10 and 3.12 must pass. A label is not clinical, novelty or hardware validation.

phases.name: Bench prototype adaptation
phases.rule: First simulated I/O, then bench-only pump/reservoir loop with independent watchdog, stop path and measured timing. No human connection or patient settings.

prototype_limitations: Fixed-step Python interface; no real-time deadline guarantee.
Observer histories currently grow with run length; bounded-memory work remains.
No physical device driver, electrical design, hardware testing or independent stop system.
Model intervals and braking reserve remain conditional engineering hypotheses.
